description: Server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that adds the /hat command.

mods.name: DuskHats
mods.description: Comando /hat del lado del servidor para equipar el objeto de la mano principal como sombrero.

releases.notes:
First stable release of DuskHats for Minecraft 26.2.

## Features

- Adds the player-only `/hat` command.
- Equips the item in the main hand into the head slot.
- Safely stores the previous hat or swaps it into the main hand when the inventory is full.
- Plays an armor equip sound and displays a green success message.
- Runs entirely on the Fabric server; players do not need the mod on their clients.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API for Minecraft 26.2
- Java 25 or newer

## Installation

Download `duskhats-1.0.0.jar` and place it in the server's `mods` directory alongside Fabric API.
